title: Notebook Metropolis
description: A city-builder-inspired note-taking web application that turns categories into interactive buildings and rooms. Users can organize notes through visual hotspots and interact with AI companions that understand the notes stored in each room.
imageAlt: Preview of the Notebook Metropolis project

title: AI Tutor Assistant
description: An AI-powered learning platform designed to make complex topics easier to understand through personalized tutoring. Users can explore subjects with different AI tutor personalities, generate study materials and quizzes, receive feedback on their answers, and identify what to study next.
imageAlt: AI Tutor Assistant interface showing an AI-powered learning conversation and study tools

title: Personal Developer Portfolio
description: A responsive personal portfolio built to showcase software development projects, technical skills, education, and professional links. The site uses a data-driven structure so content can be updated through JSON files without editing component code.
imageAlt: Preview of Ryo Masago's personal developer portfolio
